change_record.basis: snapshot captured immediately before this scoped patch

changes: Numeric dimension hints now fit one line and include the allowed range, unit, and resize effect.
The dimension group reserves 20 px around its rows so Motif's 17 px tooltip does not cover the next scale or the preview captions.
The native hint checks now expect all 12 current action buttons and test adjacent horizontal scales plus the following preview.

runtime.observation: Width hint was 412x17 at y=174; height scale begins below it. Height hint was 406x17 at y=231 and ends above the preview captions. A 300 ms hover on width followed by hover on height produced only the height hint after its delay. After leaving the controls the tooltip window was IsUnMapped.

coverage: delayed Motif hover, screen bounds, non-overlap, stability, leaving, and cancelled pending tooltip
width and height tooltip non-overlap against adjacent scale and preview
all 12 action hints match their text
